requirements.quote: An established QUIC connection can be terminated in one of three ways: * idle timeout (Section 10.1) * immediate close (Section 10.2) * stateless reset (Section 10.3)
requirements.condition: When an established QUIC connection is terminated
requirements.required_behavior: The termination mechanism is idle timeout, immediate close, or stateless reset.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not terminate an established connection using a mechanism outside the three enumerated mechanisms.
requirements.why_checkable: An implementation's connection-termination paths can be enumerated and checked against the three listed mechanisms.

requirements.quote: An endpoint MAY discard connection state if it does not have a validated path on which it can send packets; see Section 8.2.
requirements.condition: The endpoint does not have a validated path on which it can send packets.
requirements.required_behavior: The endpoint is permitted to discard connection state.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can remove all validated sending paths and verify that discarding connection state is an allowed implementation outcome.
